design_archetype: Luxury & Authority (Deep Navy, Gold, Green) - Premium Enterprise

headings.usage: Dashboard widgets, page titles, section headers. NO Inter/Roboto.

body.usage: Data tables, forms, CRM lists, standard UI text.

accent.usage: Document generation (policies, NDA), Digital Certificates, BELOTA GRC VERIFIED™ seals.

mono.usage: System inventories, IP addresses, RoPA IDs, compliance hash codes.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid borders on cards using #1A2744. For active/premium elements, use gold subtle border.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal shadows in dark mode. Use subtle glows (drop-shadow with brand gold/green at 10% opacity) for focus states or verified seals.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise/grain overlay on login screens and document covers to break digital flatness and emulate premium paper/security.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: NO transparent backgrounds for overlays, modals, or headers. Use solid #0B1426 with a 1px border for distinction.

buttons.primary: Solid #C5A059 background, #050A14 text. Minimal rounding (rounded-sm). Hover: Brighten to #D4AF37.
buttons.secondary: Transparent background, 1px solid #1A2744, #F3F4F6 text. Hover: bg-#121D36.
buttons.danger: Solid #8B2323 for critical risk actions (delete asset, breach report).

cards.style: Flat background (#0B1426), sharp or slight rounding (rounded-sm), 1px solid border (#1A2744).
cards.header: Include an overline (uppercase, tracking-widest, text-xs, text-gold) above card titles for GRC classification.

inputs.style: Solid dark background (#050A14), border (#1A2744). Focus ring should be gold (#C5A059).

tables.style: Dense padding (p-2 or p-3), distinct row hover state (#121D36), IBM Plex Sans for optimal data legibility.

grids_layouts.dashboard: High Density Grid (Bento style). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4. Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6). Use spans to prioritize the Compliance Score and Risk Matrix heatmap.
grids_layouts.spacing: Generous padding inside containers (p-6 or p-8) to maintain an authoritative, uncluttered look. Executive summaries need breathing room.
grids_layouts.navigation: Left sidebar (solid #0B1426, right border #1A2744) for Multi-portal switching (Consultant/DPO/Client).

motion.transitions: Specific properties only (e.g., transition-colors, transition-transform). NO 'transition-all'.
motion.micro_interactions: Subtle scale up on hover for dashboard widgets (-translate-y-0.5).
motion.loading: Use an elegant gold shimmer or spinning geometric shield for loading states, reflecting the BELOTA brand.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over dark navy meets APCA/WCAG standards. Use off-white (#F3F4F6) for primary text.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have a visible focus ring (ring-2 ring-[#C5A059] ring-offset-2 ring-offset-[#050A14]).

media.icons: Use Phosphor Icons or Lucide React. Style: crisp, regular weight. Color: secondary text or gold for active states.

brand_logo.description: Primary BELOTA GRC Logo and Shield. Use in Sidebar, Header, Login, and Document generation headers.

abstract_gold_texture.description: Gold geometric pattern. Use at 10-20% opacity as a background element for the Login Screen, Digital Certificate backgrounds, or premium Document Covers.

secure_data_server.description: Dark blue secure data server. Use as a header banner or empty state illustration in the Data/Systems Inventory section.

corporate_office_dark.description: Dark corporate office exterior. Can be used for CRM / Client Onboarding backgrounds.

3d_libraries.recommendation: Use Recharts for Executive Governance Dashboard and Risk Matrix Heatmaps. 3D is not recommended for strict compliance data visualization as it distorts readability. Use crisp 2D SVG charting.
3d_libraries.risk_matrix: Create a 5x5 heatmap grid using standard Tailwind grid and background colors mapping to the risk_matrix palette.

general_ui_ux_guidelines: Data Test IDs: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="login-submit-button"`, `data-testid="risk-matrix-widget"`).
No transparent backgrounds: Dropdowns, sticky headers, and modals MUST have a solid background (e.g., bg-[#0B1426]) to prevent text collision over data.
Design for Trust: GRC platforms handle sensitive data. Avoid playful animations. Stick to rigid, functional beauty, utilizing sharp edges or minimal rounding.
Hierarchy through Typography: Use gold text for data points or scores, and muted gray for labels.
Avoid AI Slop: No generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients. Use z-index hierarchy and crisp borders to separate sections.
Toasts: Use Sonner for notifications (success, warnings for non-compliance).
Empty States: Make them actionable and visually tied to the brand (e.g., a subtle gold shield outline).
instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: The environment uses .js files, NOT .tsx files. Write all React components as standard JavaScript (.js) or (.jsx) files. Do not use TypeScript annotations.
Implement the Multi-portal structure (Consultant, DPO, Client) via a clear context/state switcher in the sidebar/header.
Use Recharts for the Compliance Score donut chart and a custom Tailwind grid for the Risk Matrix (probability x impact heatmap).
For Document Generation and Certificates, utilize 'Playfair Display' for an institutional, authoritative look.
Apply 'Outfit' font for standard dashboard headings and 'IBM Plex Sans' for tabular data and forms.
Do not use generic blue/indigo. Strictly adhere to the BELOTA Navy (#050A14), Gold (#C5A059), and Green (#0F3D2B) palette.
Use standard Tailwind CSS classes. Extend tailwind.config.js with the provided colors and font families.
